:::{#exr-add-outside-span-practice}
#### Adding a third feature to an independent pair

Adding a new feature keeps a list of features [linearly independent](#def-linearly-independent)
when the new one is not a combination of the old ones,
which is what @thm-add-outside-span says.
Let

$$
\vecf{v}_1 = \sbmat{1 \\ 0 \\ 0},
\qquad
\vecf{v}_2 = \sbmat{0 \\ 1 \\ 0},
\qquad
\vecf{w} = \sbmat{1 \\ 1 \\ 1}.
$$

Are $\vecf{v}_1$, $\vecf{v}_2$ and $\vecf{w}$ linearly independent?

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Check whether $\vecf{w}$ is in $\operatorname{span}\cb{\vecf{v}_1, \vecf{v}_2}$,
then use @thm-add-outside-span.

:::

:::
